CustomField.label: Parent Record Id
CustomField.description: Polymorphic parent record Id (ADR-0022's Text-pair design, paired with Parent_Object_Api_Name__c). Blank for a root-level relationship. No native referential integrity — enforced at the app layer (OI_HierarchyValidationService), the same accepted trade-off Source_Node_Key__c/Target_Node_Key__c already carry for the metadata graph.
